messages:
harry_support: Escalating SolaceMed onboarding to CS — bulk uploads are getting truncated (partial payloads) and returning 422s. Account SLM-211, ARR ~$275k. Renewal check in ~16 days, customer is blocked.

harry_support: Quick logs: repeated error "payload_incomplete: truncated_body" and occasional 401 token_refresh failures when retries happen. Hit during a large midnight migration.

notif-bot: [incident] Created P1 case INC-2026-330 for SLM-211 assigned to customer-success. SLA: 2 business hours for initial outreach.

lena_cs: Taking point. Can support attach last 200 lines and confirm whether truncation correlates with high concurrent uploads? Planning a 25m triage call and will include engineering.

harry_support: Attached logs to INC-2026-330 and enabled org debug for 12h: `enable_org_debug SLM-211 --ttl=12h`. We saw concurrent upload spike ~4x at 00:12Z.

owen_se: Preliminary hypothesis: client-side chunking is mis-implementing content-length and our ingress aborts, causing partial bodies. Token errors likely from retry flurry. Short-term: we can 1) enable lenient chunk-check for that org, 2) bump per-org throughput for 24h, and 3) perform canary credential rotate if token errors persist. I can apply (1) and (2) if CS approves. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/ingest-troubleshoot

maya_csm: Comms plan: 1) send immediate status note and schedule 25m bridge within 1h, 2) during call apply lenient ingest and throughput bump, 3) follow-up with root-cause and next steps. I'll draft the customer blurb.

lena_cs: Proposed call 09:40 PT (in 35m). @owen_se please join for lenient ingest toggle. @harry_support please gather examples of truncated payloads and confirm whether their client library version is old.

harry_support: Done — examples attached. Also noted they use our older SDK v0.9.8 which had a known chunking bug.

owen_se: Toggled lenient chunk-check for SLM-211: `set_org_ingest_check SLM-211 --mode=lenient --duration=24h`. Also applied temporary QPS bump `set_org_qps SLM-211 --qps=260 --duration=24h`. Monitor will follow.

maya_csm: Draft status to customer:
"Hi Priya  we saw truncated uploads caused by older SDK chunking behavior and a retry spike that triggered token refresh failures. We're scheduling a 25m troubleshooting call at 09:40 PT to walk through mitigations (temporary lenient ingest, quota bump, canary credential rotate). We'll follow with a short remediation plan and a recommended SDK upgrade.  Maya, CSM"

lena_cs: Post-call update: lenient mode + QPS bump allowed retries to succeed; performed canary rotate and validated on test workspace. Customer retried blocked batches and reports successful ingestion. Next steps: 1) monitor 72h, 2) customer to upgrade SDK to latest patch, 3) schedule integration hardening session. I'll update INC-2026-330 and notify Renewals: account stable but on-watch.

harry_support: Marked P1 and pinged sales for renewal visibility.

lena_cs: Closing loop here pending 72h stability. If errors recur, escalate to Director CS & Eng. :white_check_mark:
